title: Retry an idempotent SDDC Manager depot service deletion
prompt:
Implement the root Go package `depotdelete` (module `vcf91-0028`, standard library only) as a focused VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager REST integration.

Before implementing, research the `deleteServiceConfigByKey` operation in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository and cite the specification URLs consulted. Do not contact any other SDDC Manager route.

Keep the public surface declared in `client.go`:

- `NewClient(Config) (*Client, error)`, where `Config` contains `BaseURL`, `AccessToken`, `HTTPClient`, `MaxAttempts`, and `BeforeRetry func(context.Context, int) error`. Treat `BaseURL` as an HTTP(S) origin: reject embedded credentials, query, fragment, or a non-root path. Reject a blank token, ASCII whitespace in the token, and `MaxAttempts < 1` before traffic. A nil HTTP client means `http.DefaultClient`; a nil `BeforeRetry` is a no-op. Construction performs no network I/O and redirects must not be followed.
- `(*Client).DeleteDepotServiceConfig(context.Context, string) (Result, error)` invokes `deleteServiceConfigByKey`. Require a nonblank, trimmed service key and percent-encode it as one path segment in exactly `DELETE /v1/services-config/{serviceKey}` with no query string. Validate the key before traffic. Send `Accept: application/json` and `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The DELETE has no body or `Content-Type`. Accept exactly HTTP 204, including when the key is already absent.
- Build the target once and send a byte-identical method and request target on every attempt. Retry only a transport failure or the operation's documented HTTP 500 response, up to `MaxAttempts`; do not retry HTTP 400 or an unexpected status. Invoke `BeforeRetry(ctx, completedAttempts)` only after a retryable failure when another attempt remains. A callback error or context cancellation stops immediately. Always close response bodies.
- The deletion is idempotent: an ambiguous first attempt may already have removed the configuration. Retrying must repeat the same DELETE. `Result.Attempts` counts DELETE requests and `Result.Retried` is true after more than one attempt, including when an error is returned.
- Decode error envelopes into `*APIError`, preserving `OperationID`, `StatusCode`, `ErrorCode`, `Message`, `RemediationMessage`, and `ReferenceToken`. A terminal transport failure is `*TransportError`. Error strings must not expose the bearer token, response body, or underlying transport exception text. Preserve context cancellation for `errors.Is`.

Do not modify `go.mod`, `contract_test.go`, or `internal/contractmock/`; edit only `client.go`. Run `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`.
